iteration: cumulative new optimizer updates; validation curves have boundaries, do not connect across new datasets

metric_definitions.games_per_second: observed native game command walltime including JSON output; local finite benchmark
metric_definitions.loss: per-batch policy cross entropy, value MSE, unregularized total; AdamW weight decay separate
metric_definitions.policy_entropy: mean per-game Shannon entropy of actual root visit distribution N/B; equal game weights
metric_definitions.win_rate: new checkpoint vs immediately preceding checkpoint, B128, 48 paired openings (96 games); no best-player gate

schema: original export_for_plotting metric->list of [iteration,value], wrapped with explicit scope
